identity.meaning: the actor isn't an identity the authority can stamp
identity.when: an actor outside the §3.1 grammar, or one of the authority's own (system, sim, world)

no-world.when: any verb but create-world/help on a world that hasn't been founded

custody.meaning: this server can't sign for the world
custody.when: a write to a world whose genesis names another sequencer key

unreadable.meaning: the log folds to a status the authority won't write to
unreadable.when: a write while the fold says no-world/unknown-version

repair-needed.meaning: the world's stored values are in an old spelling no reader serves; the maintenance command must run first
repair-needed.when: any write (not a read, not leave) to a world needing lift-sockets, a grabbable, picture or sound rename, or repair-shapes (authority maintenanceNeeds); the text names `bun tools/protocol/world.ts repair <name>`

ambiguous.meaning: the request's result is unknown: some or all of it may be written; never ok, never a plain failure
ambiguous.when: a durable write threw (its line may be on disk; the log is wedged until reopened), or the request was cut off after part of it was written; the reply's `from` is the first seq whose state history must settle (storage.js txnOutcome)

server-error.meaning: the server failed handling the request and nothing it asked for was written
server-error.when: a throw before any line of the request reached the log, including a write refused because the log was already wedged (rolled back)

unknown-verb.when: a verb the authority doesn't have (help lists them)

removed.meaning: the protocol had that request and removed it
removed.when: a request named in verbspec.js REMOVED_VERBS (whisper, removed 2026-10-18: speech is public and arrival-only)

banned.meaning: the actor is banned from this world
banned.when: any request but help/leave from a banned identity

muted.when: a say (or voice) while a mute is in force

rate.when: an actor's entry, say, byte, dry-run or upload budget for the window is spent

cool-down.when: repeated refusals of one class of body act (world-wide, moderator log)

pending.when: reserved: a body ask while another to the same person was waiting (the ask was removed 10-28; never logged, kept so the word isn't reused)

rights.meaning: the actor's role doesn't allow this
rights.when: a missing permission (build, editOthers, scripts…), someone else's key, a world setting below owner, a rollback below owner

rank.meaning: the other side ranks at or above you
rank.when: a lock above your rank, undoing someone ranked above you, a sanction on an equal or higher rank, an authority act

consent.meaning: that person isn't taking this right now
consent.when: a body act (touch, pose, shove, displace…) their table refuses: the same words whatever the cause (an edit that moves a seat vacates its occupants, never refused for them: §5)

body.when: reserved (PROTOCOL §7a): a write under a body root by anyone but its owner and their grantees, said with no ids, creator or did-you-mean

last-owner.meaning: the world would be left with no owner
last-owner.when: a write that removes or demotes the last owner

held.when: deleting a custom role that someone holds

needs.meaning: a permission needs another one that's off
needs.when: a role's `can` with a dependency switched off

scope.when: a script write, say, create or body effect its scope doesn't cover

barred.meaning: this action is closed until another happens first

locked.when: a write to a locked thing (or under one) without throughLock

occupied.when: a hand verb (grab, put, punt, throw, drop) on a thing someone sits or stands on, or a seat that's taken

revert-war.meaning: that's a dispute: an owner settles it
revert-war.when: reverting someone's work on a thing already reverted across people twice in the hour, below owner

shape.meaning: the request or value isn't the right shape
shape.when: a wrong type, a missing part, a bad name, a bad placeholder, anything the shape rules refuse

unknown-arg.meaning: the verb has no such argument
unknown-arg.when: an argument VERBSPEC doesn't list for the verb

missing-arg.when: a required VERBSPEC argument left out

doesnt-apply.meaning: that argument doesn't go with the mode you chose
doesnt-apply.when: a place argument whose modes exclude the chosen one; a below-bounds respawn for a body the authority last knew above @world.bounds.min.y (or nowhere), or one seated

schema.meaning: a component value the registry doesn't take
schema.when: an unknown field, an unregistered bare name, a value outside the component's schema

bounds.meaning: a number past what this server allows
bounds.when: a value above a server limit (counts, sizes, rates)

too-big.when: a value over 64 KiB, a log line over 1 MiB or 64 deep, a script source or batch over its cap

reserved.meaning: a name held for a shape that isn't settled
reserved.when: writing a reserved component, field or handler kind, or sending a reserved request (arrive)

stamped.meaning: the authority writes that field, never a request
stamped.when: a stamped field (a sky's ts, a physics build…) in a write

derived.when: writing a derived field (a motion's pivot) instead of its source

legacy.when: a pre-cut shape (a socket as a parent field) in a new write

imported.meaning: an imported world's record isn't written by hand

server-written.when: a request or handler setting a server-written component

caption-only.meaning: captions are written by the caption request

caption.meaning: that caption line was refused by the caption rules
caption.when: a resend, an out-of-order n, a superseded leg

one-place.meaning: a thing is in one place
one-place.when: two ways of saying where it is (a socket and a parent, two seats…)

world-only.when: a world component written on a thing

thing-only.meaning: that component belongs to a thing

schema-fixed.when: changing or deleting a set schemas:<name>

grid-fixed.meaning: the terrain grid is fixed while it has tiles
grid-fixed.when: changing terrain-grid with tiles under it

syntax.when: installing a script whose source has a syntax error

source.meaning: a script's source isn't usable text
source.when: a non-string or missing source at upload or install

source-bom.meaning: the source starts with a byte-order mark
source-bom.when: upload or install of a source with a BOM

trojan-source.when: a bidi control or zero-width character in a script source

long-line.when: a script source with a line reviewers can't see

confirm.when: a rollback of more than 20 acts without confirm

no-detail.meaning: no detailed help for that verb yet
no-detail.when: help {verb} for a verb without a VERBSPEC row

not-found.meaning: no such thing (or component, socket, ask…)
not-found.when: an id, component, socket, ask or blueprint part that isn't there

gone.when: a hand verb on a held thing that no longer exists

not-here.meaning: that body isn't in the world
not-here.when: a body act on someone absent, or your own before you arrive

not-a-thing.when: a hand or place verb on a socket

not-a-copy.when: update on a thing with no copy-of

not-published.when: update to a hash this world hasn't published

exists.when: create-world on a world that exists, or a create of an id that does

reused.when: a create of an id this world has had before

nothing.when: a write whose ops all elide, an undo with nothing of yours to take back

nothing-to-reset.meaning: nothing was reset: every target was already home or was skipped, each skip saying why
nothing-to-reset.when: a reset whose targets are all at home or all skipped, or that names none

changed.when: expect: a component isn't the value the gesture started from

stale.meaning: someone changed it since the version you read
stale.when: a set with a base older than the component's last write

other-branch.meaning: that version is from another history
other-branch.when: a version {seq, head} whose head this log doesn't have

conflict.when: undo landing on others' later work; a dynamic thing told to face something; contradictory settings

conflicts.meaning: parts changed both here and upstream
conflicts.when: a blueprint update without resolve for parts edited on both sides

founding.meaning: founding a world can't be undone

physical.meaning: physics decided that, not an edit
physical.when: undo of a throw, drop or leave

disabled.when: handling, using or standing on a thing that is (or hangs under) disabled

in-flight.meaning: the engine has it until it rests
in-flight.when: any write to a launched thing before its rest

not-at-rest.meaning: the engine doesn't have it at rest
not-at-rest.when: a rest the engine doesn't agree with

implausible.when: a put or place whose result floats or interpenetrates

full.meaning: this world is at its entity limit
full.when: a write that adds entities past capacity

too-costly.meaning: more of the authority's time than one request may have
too-costly.when: a request past the work budget

busy.when: an engine cut with things in flight (without force), or the scripts' share of the second is spent

budget.when: an activation past the world's, the sponsor's or the script's hourly/per-minute budget

depth.meaning: a script cascade went too deep
depth.when: an activation whose cause chain passes this server's cascade depth (its operator sets it, not the world's owner)

ground-loading.when: a write needing the heightmap before its grid is on this server

loop.meaning: that would make a parent loop
loop.when: a parent chain that comes back to itself

deep.meaning: the parent chain is 32 deep already
deep.when: a parent past the depth cap

in-the-way.meaning: someone is where it would go
in-the-way.when: a shove or push that would slide a thing into a body

solid.when: an arrival or step into something solid

spawn.meaning: arrivals are limited to the world's arrival places
spawn.when: an arrival, teleport or below-bounds respawn outside every arrival place's radius (@world.spawn and the spawn-point things)

too-fast.meaning: faster than a body (or a throw) may go
too-fast.when: a step past the speed track, a throw or shove over its cap

out-of-reach.when: a hand or body act beyond its reach

hold-limit.meaning: you are holding as many things as you may

not-holding.when: put, throw or drop of a thing not in your hand

not-grabbable.when: a grab of a thing with no grabbable and no dynamic physics

not-dynamic.when: a punt of a thing without dynamic physics

no-grip.when: a grab naming a grip the thing doesn't have

wrong-hand.meaning: that grip is for the other hand
wrong-hand.when: a grab whose grip names the other hand

wrong-way.meaning: a contact push sends it away from the body
wrong-way.when: a shove velocity more than 60° off straight away

beneath.meaning: a body moves over it, not into it
beneath.when: a contact push of a thing beneath the body

sideways.when: a push across a pendulum's swing plane

not-pushable.meaning: a push doesn't change that motion
not-pushable.when: an impulse to a thing whose motion isn't a pendulum

no-pivot.meaning: it swings but hangs from nothing
no-pivot.when: a push to a pendulum with no hang point above

no-physics.meaning: this world has no physics running
no-physics.when: throw, punt or launch in a world without physics-engine

unknown-engine.meaning: this server doesn't carry that engine
unknown-engine.when: setting physics-engine to an engine not in ENGINES

foreign-engine.meaning: the world runs an engine version this server doesn't carry
foreign-engine.when: what only that engine computes: a launch, or a grab or delete that would set a resting thing falling

no-shape.when: a launch of a thing with no model or mesh

no-surface.meaning: it has no surface to put things on
no-surface.when: place {on} a thing with no measured surfaces

no-room.when: place {on} a surface with no free room for it

unsupported.when: place {beside} where there's no support on that side

inside.meaning: that would put it inside something solid
inside.when: a hang or place into a thing's solid parts

no-grid.when: a sculpt on ground without terrain-grid

no-model.when: measure of a thing with no model or mesh

no-target.when: a set handler naming a field of a component the thing doesn't have

no-action.when: use of a thing with no reactions and no station

no-handler.when: use with an action the thing doesn't have

no-runtime.when: use of a behaviour binding imported from the old engine

no-sound.meaning: it has no sound to play
no-sound.when: a play handler on a thing with no sound

action-taken.when: a socket's station action that a reaction on the host already uses

name-taken.when: two sockets of one host with one name

outside-link.meaning: a link points outside what you publish
outside-link.when: publish of a set whose refs name things outside it
